name: playpets
description: A desktop pet you can talk to, powered by your own AI subscription
author: gaerae

scripts.lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && biome ci
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --release --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node tests/e2e.mjs
scripts.dist:windows: docker build -t playpets-windows packaging/windows && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src:ro -v playpets-cargo-win:/usr/local/cargo/registry -v playpets-target-win:/work/src-tauri/target -v "$PWD/release/windows":/out playpets-windows
scripts.dist:linux: docker build -t playpets-linux packaging/linux && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src:ro -v playpets-cargo:/usr/local/cargo/registry -v playpets-target:/work/src-tauri/target -v "$PWD/release/linux":/out playpets-linux
scripts.measure: cargo build --release --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/measure.mjs
scripts.shots: cargo build --release --features e2e --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/shots.mjs
